published_ranges._notes: Tg and Vicat are from Polymaker's own shop page. HDT 0.45 MPa (133.7C) is from the official fiberon.polymaker.com product page. HDT 1.8 MPa (87.3C, annealed) is from a reseller reproduction of the TDS. The original Fiberon TDS PDF could not be fetched this run. The bed range 70-80 is from the official Fiberon product page. Density, drying and speed are from a reseller copy (setterox). Polymaker advises using parts unannealed when heat resistance above 80C is not needed. The bambu_parent was not confirmed: use 'Bambu PET-CF' if no Generic PET-GF preset exists. Earlier entry: TDS text layer has the thermal table misaligned (values 231.6 / 201.4 / 422.8 / 232.6 / 87.3 C could not be matched to rows reliably), so Tg/Vicat/HDT are omitted. TDS: brass nozzle life about 9 h, keep below 20% RH; anneal only if >80C resistance is needed. bambu_parent is the brand's PET composite preset (CF, not GF).
